routing_warnings.description: This message requests mobile-phone framing within the hero artwork, not responsive rendering on mobile displays.
This commitment concerns the mobile-phone hero presentation rather than mobile-responsive page behavior.
This message concerns replacing the hero image with a sales-page graphic depicted on a mobile phone, not responsive layout behavior.
The reported typo concerns contact-page content rather than the early-access CTA routing.
The test submission exercises contact-form lead delivery rather than navigation from the early-access CTA.
The confirmed lead arrival verifies the contact-form workflow, not the early-access CTA routing.
This message reports that the marketing-site launch disrupted the existing product root-domain route; the concrete runtime failure belongs to the product root-domain Requirement.
The client requests restoration of the old root-domain record rather than changing the marketing site's selected subdomain.
The message concretely verifies restoration of the product root domain.
The same message separately reports that the product www domain still shows a Site Not Found page.
This completion message concerns publishing the Webflow marketing site at the then-selected custom domain, not restoring the product root-domain route.
This message selects get.drivereel.example as the marketing-site subdomain.
The same message separately reports that www.drivereel.example shows a Site Not Found page and requires restoration in Firebase Hosting.
The opening clause separately verifies that the root product domain was restored and is serving normally; that observation belongs to the root-domain Requirement.
The no-animation constraint is better routed to the separately inventoried landing-page animation policy Requirement.
Removing the email and phone actions while retaining only the contact-request option changes the contact page's available actions rather than its Founding Dealer copy.
This message describes Request Early Access navigation to the contact page rather than the action options displayed on that page.
This implementation status concerns connecting the early-access button to the contact page.
This message supplies contact-page explanatory copy rather than changing its available actions.
This message specifies the contact-page headline.
This message defines the contact form's captured fields.
This message adds a comment field to the contact form.
The reported contact-page typo concerns displayed content, not the available contact actions.
This message reports execution of a test lead submission through the form workflow.
This message verifies successful lead delivery through the contact workflow.
This message changes the available contact-page action options rather than the form lead-delivery workflow.
This message specifies the contact-form field schema, which belongs to the narrower field-capture Requirement.
This message adds a comment field and belongs to the narrower field-capture Requirement.
The reported contact-page typo concerns page content and does not establish a failure of lead delivery.
The requested recipient email addresses govern lead delivery rather than which fields the form captures.
The reported contact-page typo concerns page content and does not identify a field-capture failure.
The test submission exercises the end-to-end lead flow but does not establish that each required field was captured.
The client verifies lead arrival and workflow operation, not the capture of each specified form field.
